company.description:
remberg is the modern maintenance software that simplifies how industrial companies manage maintenance.

With remberg, maintenance teams plan and document preventive maintenance, handle breakdowns and manage technical documentation in one central system. Assets, work orders and knowledge are always available – structured, mobile and easy to use.

remberg enables clear processes, better collaboration and full transparency across maintenance operations, so teams can avoid working in constant firefighting mode. This helps to reduce unplanned downtime and maintenance costs, while keeping you audit-ready.

We simplify maintenance so that companies can keep the world running.
